testimonials.text: I absolutely loved the user experience here, quizzes at the end of each module helped a lot in solidifying gained information before moving to the next level rather than having all questions accumulated at the very last. The course was enriching and helped to understand better, and delve more deep in definitions and differentiate between concepts I thought were identical prior to going through this training.

The course clearly demonstrated how community engagement and involvement can be applied in real surgical research projects, showing step-by-step examples from multiple countries. I appreciated how the course clarified the differences and intersections between qualitative research, participation, engagement, and involvement, making it easier to plan studies effectively.
I liked the Q/A which helped draw a very clear distinction between Qualitative Research and CEIs.
Helped me know the difference between CEI and qualitative research. It helped learn the difference between engagement, involvement and participation.

Grateful for going through this course. It has refreshed my confidence in discussing the values of involving patients, carers and the community in my research projects. Also, this course clearly defines and clarifies what community engagement and involvement (CEI) are and their difference to traditional view of patients and carers within research.

Practical, real-world examples, I liked how the course used clear case studies and scenarios (e.g., surgical research, stoma support groups) to show the difference between CEI and qualitative research. Clarity in concepts, the course made it easy to distinguish between engagement, involvement, and participation, which are often confused.
